page.title: Mythical Void Updates | The Signal Log
page.description: See what is newly live in Mythical Void: game stories, useful resources and honest release notes linked to the playable browser game.
page.heading: What changed in the Void.
page.introduction: Real releases, useful new ways to explore, and clear notes about what is still being built. No vague promises and no invented player numbers.

entries.title: Real gameplay now fits every screen
entries.summary: One checked Mythical Void gameplay recording is now available as vertical, square and wide branded video, ready for adults, press and creators to review without changing what the game really shows.
details: Every version preserves the complete moving phone-game frame and adds branding only around it; no generated motion, replacement scenery, replacement interface or replacement audio is used.
The silent 19.58-second videos come in 1080 by 1920, 1080 by 1080 and 1920 by 1080 formats, with downloadable posters and an exact build record.
Three source-bound caption drafts use the clean Playable Now link, make no absolute uniqueness claim and remain unposted until an official channel and Kevin approval exist.
entries.imageAlt: Square Mythical Void branded video poster with a complete real gameplay frame and the words Crash beyond mapped space, hatch something strange
entries.disclosure: Poster from a branded social edit containing the complete real gameplay frame. The surrounding words and layout are not gameplay. No player identity or private save is shown.

entries.title: See the real game before you play
entries.summary: A new Mythical Void page gives unfamiliar players one clear view of the real browser game, what they do in it and why the project is different before asking them to play.
details: The page leads with a 19.58-second recording made directly from the running Mythical Forest level, with no generated frames or replacement scenery.
It explains the crash, creature, six realms, restoration, Sanctuary building and Project Beacon choice in plain language, with four real game screens as proof.
Every Play link goes directly to the free browser game without an account, download, email signup or tracking parameter.
entries.imageAlt: Real Mythical Void gameplay in the Mythical Forest with platforming controls and route display
entries.disclosure: Poster captured from the real browser game using an invented test state; no generated frames, player identity or personal save information are shown.

entries.title: The Signal Log can now travel
entries.summary: The checked Mythical Void release log is now available as an RSS feed for people and a JSON feed for future studio tools—without requiring an account or email signup.
details: Both feeds are built from the same checked source as the public Signal Log, so titles, links and media notes cannot quietly drift apart.
Every item keeps a clean mythicalvoid.com destination, its artwork or gameplay disclosure and no tracking parameters.
Following the feed happens in the reader a person chooses; Mythical Void does not collect an email address, account or recipient.
entries.imageAlt: Wide Mythical Void Project Beacon sharing artwork with a real gameplay frame
entries.disclosure: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay capture; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot and no player information is shown.

entries.title: The father-and-son story is ready to share
entries.summary: Adults, press and creators can now share wide or square artwork explaining how an Irish father-and-son experiment with imagination and generative AI tools became a playable browser game.
details: Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/studio address with no tracking code.
The background is labelled as AI-generated marketing artwork, while the framed first-contact screen is real gameplay.
No photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is used.
entries.imageAlt: Square Mythical Void founder-story artwork saying One enormous idea, built together, with the studio emblem and a real first-contact game frame
entries.disclosure: Founder-story sharing artwork, not a raw screenshot. The background is AI-generated marketing artwork, not gameplay; the framed screen is real gameplay using a company-controlled test state. No player information, photograph, name or identifying detail of the child is shown.

entries.title: A real-space sharing kit is ready
entries.summary: Adults, families, educators and creators can now share wide or square Mythical Void artwork built around a real game screen and a credited NASA Apollo 11 image.
details: Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/nasa-space-science address with no tracking code.
The framed screen comes from the running game and clearly credits the NASA public image inside it.
The complete layouts are branded sharing artwork, not raw screenshots, and NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.
entries.imageAlt: Square Mythical Void space-discovery artwork with a real game screen, credited Apollo 11 image and an observation question
entries.disclosure: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay screen containing a credited NASA public image; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot, no player information is shown, and NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

entries.title: Shared links now carry the right picture
entries.summary: The Project Beacon story and other important Mythical Void pages now give social apps a clearer image, description and accessible image text when someone shares a link.
details: The Project Beacon story now uses its purpose-built wide sharing artwork instead of a generic or easily cropped image.
Seven public pages carry checked image sizes and matching alternative text for large link previews.
Every preview keeps its clean mythicalvoid.com destination and the artwork-versus-gameplay boundary.
entries.imageAlt: Wide Mythical Void sharing artwork headed Earth sent you looking for hope, with a real Project Beacon gameplay frame
entries.disclosure: Branded sharing artwork built around a real gameplay capture; the complete layout is not a raw screenshot and no player information is shown.

entries.title: Share the game from the first screen
entries.summary: A new Share the game button now sits beside Play on the Mythical Void homepage, making it easier for someone who enjoys the idea to pass it on.
details: On supported phones and computers, the button opens the device's normal sharing choices.
Where device sharing is unavailable, it copies the clean mythicalvoid.com address instead.
The shared address contains no tracking code, and the Mythical Void control does not collect a recipient or contact details.

entries.title: Project Beacon artwork is ready to share
entries.summary: Adults, press and creators can now download polished square and wide Project Beacon artwork from the press room, built around a real game capture and a clean story link.
details: Both layouts show the clean mythicalvoid.com/story address with no tracking code.
The framed Project Beacon scene comes from the real running browser game using an invented test state.
The complete layouts are branded sharing artwork, not raw gameplay screenshots.

entries.title: A new way to share the game
entries.summary: Adults can now download a one-page Mythical Void card, print it or send it, and use its QR code to open the free browser game.
details: The QR code goes straight to mythicalvoid.com with no tracking code attached.
The card includes one real Project Beacon game screen.
The large creature-universe image is clearly labelled as generated artwork, not gameplay.

entries.title: The Project Beacon story is live
entries.summary: A new spoiler-light story page now explains the crash of Wanderer-77, first contact, six living realms and the choice waiting at the heart of Project Beacon.
details: Six realm images come from the real running game.
The page explains why the guardians are restored rather than destroyed.
The ending remains for players to discover themselves.
